syncIntervalValue.label: Interval
syncIntervalValue.help: 0 = disabled. When set, all target datapoints are re-written at this interval with the last known source value (heartbeat/refresh). Only the forward direction (source → target) is synced; the reverse direction of bidirectional entries is not included in periodic updates.

relayOnChange.label: Also relay on change (in addition to periodic sync)
relayOnChange.help: When periodic sync is active (interval > 0), also relay immediately on source value change. Has no effect when interval is 0 — event-driven relay is always active then.

hdr_defaults.text: Relay defaults are applied to all mapping entries unless overridden per entry.

enabledDefault.label: Enable flag default
enabledDefault.help: Initial state of the per-channel enabled datapoint. Can be overridden per entry via the 'enabled' field of the mapping entry and toggled at runtime via the channels.<id>.enabled datapoints.

hdr_coerce.text: Type coercion casts the source value to the target datapoint's type before writing. Only acts on type mismatch; matching types are passed through unchanged.

coerceTypesDefault.label: Coerce types (bool ↔ number, C convention)
coerceTypesDefault.help: Cast between boolean and number following C conventions: number 0 → false / non-0 → true, false → 0 / true → 1. Applied on both event relay and periodic sync.

coerceStringsDefault.label: Also interpret strings
coerceStringsDefault.help: Additionally interpret strings when coercing: ""/"0"/"false" → false, else → true; numeric strings → number. Unrecognized strings are passed through unchanged. Off by default (extra effort, opt-in).
